runs.name: Innodata Inc.; Nasdaq INOD, Delaware, 10-K filer; data engineering for AI (training and evaluation data for model builders), with Synodex and Agility
runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Run at the operator's request ("Run innodata and cintas"), interactive dispatch under the canonical brief, two analysts in parallel, lock held by the main session; the brief's one departure is the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25. Price **$44.74** (2026-10-27, aggregator, flagged) x **34,382,651 shares** (one class, 10-Q cover) = cap **$1,538M**; sovereign **5.30%** (Treasury 30-year). Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE): Digital Data Solutions decides (five-year pre-tax income $70.3M against a total of $54.6M; Agility -$14.3M, Synodex -$1.4M); its ten-year economics turn on how much human-made training and evaluation data a handful of model builders will buy, in an industry the 10-K calls fast-changing, with "relatively few barriers preventing companies from entering the markets in which we operate"; one customer 58% of 2025 revenue (48% in 2024, under 10% in 2023), two customers 71% of Q2 2026 revenue and 66% of receivables; contracts terminable on 30 to 90 days with no purchase commitment. Revenue $63.1M (2016) down to $55.9M (2019), then $86.8M (2023), $170.5M (2024), $251.7M (2025); pre-tax income negative in six of seven years 2016 to 2022. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash before interest -$1.66M, -$11.66M, -$4.00M, $22.65M, $22.86M (2021 to 2025), mean $5.64M; the series changes sign so (b) leaves the no-growth case alone: range **$10.33 a share** ($106.3M plus $248.7M of net cash); fair price **$8.87 all-equity (central)**, $1.71 equity-only; no case earns the floor, about 25% a year for ten years needed. Facts after the stop: retained earnings gone by 2022 (-$9.7M), equity rebuilt to $159.5M by June 2026; no debt; June 2026 cash includes a $67.0M customer advance; a Wolfpack short report (February 2024, read through secondary sources only); a securities class action dismissed with prejudice 2026-06-10; SEC and DOJ subpoenas closed June 2025 without action; an interim finance chief from at least December 2023 to July 2026; a $300M at-the-market programme registered August 2026 while holding about $250M of cash; stock pay $0.7M to $11.1M, CEO pay $12.05M in 2025. Competitors (operating margin over ten years, own filings): G 11.5% to 14.8%, EXLS 5.6% to 15.0%, CTSH 12.7% to 17.4%; INOD's summed pre-tax margin 4.9%. **Lapse declared in the file: the run was written in one pass after Q1 closed, not committed question by question (operator rule 1, write-early); three commits, own paths only.** Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; 22 ids clean (the analyst's check). Contamination declared: `Screens/` file names, other analysts' paths and commit subjects, an aggregator tag naming a person tied to a large tech company (not used). Position note filled at the fold: not held. No alert (closed before Q7).
runs.narr: TOO HARD (NATURE) at Q1: an AI-data contractor whose earnings depend on what a few model builders buy, with one customer at 58% of revenue on 30 to 90 days' notice, in a field its own 10-K says is easy to enter. Computation only: range $10.33 vs $44.74, fair $8.87. Lost all its historical profit by 2022 before the AI boom; now holds $250M of cash and registered a $300M share-sale programme.
